lenses.assessment: The Builder checked corner path and native member face/UV seam relate to existing RIG-OWNER81-F002; ResolvedSolid directly preserves checked cuboid leaves while shape/support contracts remain distinct.

Position, CuboidDimensions, RigidRotation, Radians, CollisionCuboid and specific IDs already exist; maintain truthful local versus architectural frames and reuse exact admitted leaves where appropriate.

Quaternion and cuboid envelope have checked adapters. Resolved shape payload, graph membership, raw public mesh attributes and extreme derived values require separately traced supported inputs; no whole-plan guarantee assumed.

UV local projection and position phase compute raw float results; mesh pushes cast vertex length to u32. Real finite/work/index limits are unresolved and prior SEGOVB-INITIAL04-CONTRACT-601 is related without extra count.

Envelope, shape, role, owner, identity and support graph carry coupled meaning. Local leaf validity does not alone prove that relation. Actual producer and recipient policy must govern rather than assuming arbitrary raw construction is a supported product.

Distinct GeometryOwnerId, ResolvedItemId, wall/opening and structural IDs have separate semantics. Existing checked geometry owners and source-part frame should not be conflated with a final grounded furniture frame.
Same field set projects to and from cuboid envelope; shape is a different geometric representation, not automatically redundant. Historical CONT07-CONTRACT-580 expressly records this distinction.

P16 and current objects match exactly, but overall snapshots and generation behavior are not equated. Future changes must preserve valid zero-sized cuboid representation, exact rotation and UV/winding and typed source errors.

Named SolidRole and ResolvedSolidShape express closed choices. The associated i8 side/depth signs and raw payloads require usage/admission analysis; a producer emits ±1 but no universal invalid-state remedy is inferred.

Identity newtypes use derives; OpeningAssemblyId Display formats its integer. ResolvedSolid custom Deserialize routes through the checked adapter; no derive equivalence or serializer-wire behavior is assumed.

Cuboid envelope, noncuboid authored shape, mesh UV and physical identity have different purposes. UV phase is unbounded texture space, not a UnitInterval; zero cuboid dimensions are not automatically forbidden by the owner.

No production string API occurs in member UV. Serde snake_case tagged variants are external format identities and Display renders an ordinal; treat format behavior as contract, not an internal magic string replacement.

Axes/signs, face topology, phase coefficients, UV scale and u32 capacity have different semantics. Fixed 2-metre UV unit and axis basis are explicit geometry policy; evaluate derived arithmetic and ownership before treating all native scalars alike.
